title: Script-Contrastive Identity Lattice
summary: Fuse distinctive English-word, Han-character, and public-mark evidence as independent positive place-identity carriers; carrier conflict or missing evidence remains UNKNOWN, and a proof is joined asymmetrically to the appearance fallback.

mechanisms.name: Distinctive multilingual carrier lattice with conflict veto
mechanisms.description: Fold traditional/simplified Han variants, weight English words and Han uni/bi-grams by candidate-pack distinctiveness, keep public marks separate, add only a small agreement bonus, veto strong cross-carrier disagreement, and let a proved entity authorize only itself while UNKNOWN preserves appearance.
mechanisms.limitations: Confirmed only on eight fresh curated public-image queries in the test split. Identity-bearing opportunity was deliberately stratified; the mechanism is not open-world place recognition and does not bind a portal by itself.
